The '''Patrolia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Patrolia/Legends|Patrolia]].

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' and [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]], this system was initially misspelled "Pitrolea". Author [[Jason Fry]] clarified and linked the [[Patrolian/Legends|Patrolian]] species with the planet. This was finally corrected in the latest version of the Online Companion.<ref name="JFTFN">{{JCFCite|url=posts/30892772|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2010-04-21|time=7:50 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200802112338/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-141}}</ref>
